name: Smash Burger
description: Two dry-aged beef patties smashed on the plancha till lacy at the edges, American cheese, butter lettuce, beef tomato and house burger sauce in a toasted sesame brioche bun.

name: Margherita
description: 48-hour fermented dough blistered in the wood oven, San Marzano tomato, fior di latte, fresh basil and a ribbon of Sicilian olive oil.

name: Tonkotsu Ramen
description: 18-hour pork bone broth, springy wheat noodles, torched chashu belly, a soy-marinated jammy egg, spring onion and nori.

name: Nigiri Selection
description: Five pieces over seasoned rice: Scottish salmon, bluefin tuna and yellowtail, with pickled ginger and fresh wasabi.

name: Chocolate Layer Cake
description: Three layers of dark chocolate sponge with whipped ganache, finished with a mirror glaze and cocoa nib crumb.

name: Birria Tacos
description: Three corn tortillas with slow-braised beef, salsa roja, white onion, coriander and a wedge of lime.

name: Iced Oat Latte
description: Double shot of our house espresso poured over oat milk and ice.
